VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 independently reviewed HEAD a8fde8192bea44755d24fcdeede5ea32da30a26e against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc and the hash-matching pinned spec, with per-criterion verdicts: AC-3 NOT SATISFIED (src/math.mjs:72 returns 3 for [3,1,2] and 1 for [5], instead of 2 and 0); R-1 SATISFIED (src/math.mjs:69-71 matches mean validation and 16 validation assertions passed); R-2 SATISFIED (src/math.mjs:69-72 reads input without writes and frozen-input probe passed); R-3 SATISFIED (full diff preserves src/math.mjs:1-66 and existing test cases, changing only the permitted import at test/math.test.mjs:3); R-4 SATISFIED (package.json:1 unchanged and full diff contains only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs, with no dependency or generated-file changes); R-5 SATISFIED (test/math.test.mjs:85 uses the range prefix).

Findings: HIGH at src/math.mjs:72, adding 1 violates max-minus-min semantics and both explicit AC-3 examples, verify fixed with assertions range([3,1,2]) === 2 and range([5]) === 0; MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:86, the sole range test expects the incorrect value 3 and omits the singleton and validation cases, masking the implementation defect, verify fixed by correcting the expected value and adding range-prefixed singleton, invalid-input and nonmutation coverage that rejects the current implementation; MEDIUM at src/math.mjs:72, spreading all elements into Math.max/Math.min exceeds the runtime argument limit for valid large arrays, so range(Array(1_000_000).fill(5)) throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded rather than returning 0, verify fixed with that input and an implementation without unbounded argument spreading.

Checks run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^range" test/ exited 0 with "tests 1", "pass 1", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 16", "pass 15", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing as explicitly expected and unchanged; independent in-memory Node probes printed "AC-3 range([3,1,2]): actual=3 expected=2", "AC-3 range([5]): actual=1 expected=0", "R-1 validation: 16 assertions passed", "R-2 frozen input: passed", and the large-array RangeError; git diff --check exited 0 and git status --porcelain was empty; the initial heredoc probe could not execute because the shell required a forbidden temporary file, so the same probe ran directly in memory with node -e; no files changed, no withheld narratives read, no required checks unavailable, and remaining uncertainty is limited to unexhaustive inputs and the engine-dependent array size at which argument spreading fails, with implementation repairs and corrected tests left to the coordinator.
